about_the_game:
Battle For Abraham VR is a single player open world VR shooter that simulates modern early 21st century warfare. It simulates the Russia/Ukraine war in the Donbas, a region in Eastern Ukraine. It also simulates the conflicts in the "land of the Prophets" (West Asia/Middle East). "Guerrilla warfare" has replaced "frontline" warfare. 21st century warriors are expected to directly face tanks, drones, rockets, and enemy soldiers simultaneously.

The base game comes with one map/mission named The Ukraine with the option to purchase additional paid DLC maps. The player will choose solo missions to clear forests, villages, warehouses, and other destinations of enemy soldiers using one Rifle, with Realistic gun mechanics, but with a catch: a limited amount of ammunition. The mission is complete when ALL the occupied lands on each map are liberated from the opposing enemy. Take cover because once again, the World is At War, and the Battle For Abraham continues.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5800X, Intel Core i7-12700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 10 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR HMD devices. Valve Index, Pimax. Requires motion controllers
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D, Intel Core i9-13900K
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 16 GB and up VRAM for a smoother experience
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR HMD devices. Valve Index, Pimax. Requires motion controllers

short_description: Battle For Abraham VR is a single player open world VR shooter. The player will choose missions to clear forests and villages of enemy soldiers using one rifle with a limited amount of ammunition. To reach enemy positions, you must avoid or destroy drones, tanks, and other heavy weaponry.
